environment: Local Worker with remote AI binding; user-confirmed Workers Free account

results.translatedText: Können Sie mir sagen, wo sich der Bahnhof befindet?
results.assessment: Meaning and formal Sie preserved; slightly less tentative than Spanish podría / German könnten.

results.translatedText: Ich trinke keinen Kaffee, weil ich danach nicht schlafen kann.
results.assessment: Both negations and causal/time relationship preserved.

results.translatedText: Gestern habe ich um neun Uhr angefangen zu arbeiten, aber heute bin ich früher angekommen.
results.assessment: Yesterday/today contrast, time and both clauses preserved; natural German.

results.translatedText: Anna hat zwei Bücher und das Ticket kostet 12 Euro.
results.assessment: Numbers and currency preserved, but proper name Ana changed to Anna. Name-fidelity failure.

results.translatedText: Ich saß auf einer Bank in der Nähe des Flusses.
results.assessment: Bench context preserved; sitting-down action rendered as a seated state, losing aspect nuance.

decision: Continue to a clearly labelled UI prototype; do not claim general quality from six examples. Add proper-name and action/state cases to future evaluation. No automatic spelling/name correction is applied.
usage: Six successful model calls; neuron/token consumption not measured. No claim of exact per-request cost.
